## Synopsis

Lists the access rows of roles on servers. A role's access row as code lives in its
Role document: strazactl roles export prints it, and strazactl drafts create -f
proposes a changed one, which a person then publishes.

```
strazactl bindings [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
